scope: Proposed 20–50-case batch only. These are developer planning scenarios, not approved demand forecasts, measured calls, or a submitted Growth Check. The synthetic review page makes no provider API calls.
cacheAssumption: Current adapter reuses category taxonomy within a single lookup. Cross-case and cross-run reuse is not assumed. Each category requires one properties plus four value requests if fully resolved.
retryAssumption: A maximum of one full manual rerun per case is budgeted in the rerun and stress scenarios. It is not automatic retry behavior. New runs require a revised plan.
